content: Every column `network_loader._stop_record` emits must be present. Extra columns are allowed: exports from the raw zone carry the `year`/`month`/`day` partition keys.

The Overpass query emits route relations first and their member nodes second, so a response cut off mid-stream loses stops before it loses routes: the routes table can look intact while this one collapses. 485 stops were served by a route on 2026-08-19.
One row per physical stop. `parse_network` deduplicates stops shared across routes; a duplicate means that collapsed, or that two snapshots were mixed into one batch.
OSM node ids, stored as strings. Catches a numeric round-trip that turns `262203745` into `262203745.0`, which would break the join from route_stops.

South and north edges of `QUITO_BBOX` in ingestion/constants.py, `(south, west, north, east) = (-0.45, -78.65, 0.05, -78.30)`. The Overpass query filters *relations* by this box, but then fetches *all* their member nodes, so a stop outside it is possible in principle and means a route that leaves the city. `tests/test_quality_suites.py` fails if these numbers drift from the constant; dbt/tests/assert_stops_within_quito_bbox.sql re-checks the same box in the warehouse.
West and east edges of `QUITO_BBOX`. Also the cheapest possible lat/lon swap detector: a swapped pair lands near (-78, -0.2), far outside both ranges.
The OSM `public_transport` tag on a node. Null is acceptable (70 of 485 stops carried no tag on 2026-08-19) and is ignored by this check; a value outside the PTv2 vocabulary is not.
Too sparse to analyse (7 of 485 stops tagged), which is why no mart depends on it, but when present it must be a boolean tag.
ISO-8601 in UTC, as written by `datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()`.

meta.description: Expectations for the raw OSM stop nodes (stops.parquet). Validates presence of the columns network_loader emits, null constraints on the identifier and coordinates, coordinates inside the Quito bounding box (QUITO_BBOX), the PTv2 tag vocabulary, and a minimum stop count that guards against a truncated Overpass response. One of three suites covering the network snapshot.

content: Validated by `raw_samples_checkpoint` against `data/samples/network/stops.parquet`. Its row count is also consumed by `network_route_stops_suite` for the referential-integrity check, so it must run first in the checkpoint.
